items.name: whoosh
items.text: A short soft airy swoosh for a slide transition in a clean motion-graphics video. No music.

items.name: pop
items.text: A soft rounded UI pop, like a bubble button appearing. Short and clean. No music.

items.name: drop
items.text: A light soft thud of a paper card landing on a desk, short, for a UI card appearing. No music.

items.name: ding
items.text: A bright soft single notification chime ding, pleasant and short. No music.

items.name: strike
items.text: A fast marker pen swipe across paper, one quick strike-through stroke. No music.

items.name: typing
items.text: Soft quick laptop keyboard typing, about eight keystrokes, close and clean. No music.

items.name: scribble
items.text: A red marker writing quickly on paper, a short handwritten scribble. No music.

items.name: hit
items.text: A deep soft cinematic boom hit for a title reveal, short with a gentle tail. No music.

items.name: bed
items.text: Light upbeat minimal lo-fi electronic study background music: warm electric piano chords, soft plucks, gentle clean beat around 100 BPM. Motivating but calm, sparse, made to sit under a Chinese female voiceover. No vocals, no big drops.
